Android 17 Camera Image Test Suite release notes Stay organized with collections Save and categorize content based on your preferences.

The Android 17 release includes a number of changes to Camera ITS.

Python and package versions

For Android 17 and higher, we strongly recommend using package management software to bundle the correct versions of packages. FFmpeg 7.0.2 is required.

New or updated scenes

Android 17 introduces the following scenes: gen2_chart uses the test_chart_gen2 paper chart instead of tablet scenes to improve test consistency. wide_gamut is a new scene for tablets with wide gamut support.

New tests

Android 17 introduces test_tonemap_sequence, which verifies the android.tonemap.mode parameter is applied correctly. It also adds test_jca_jpegr_ip and test_display_p3.

Separated test activities

In Android 17, for parallel testing on separate devices, the camera ITS tests are separated into two CTS Verifier activities, Camera ITS Test and Camera ITS Sensor Fusion Rig Test.

Gen2 rig updates

Android 17 migrated test_multi_camera_switch, all flash tests, and all sensor_fusion tests to the Gen2 rig.

New test status: PASS*

Android 17 introduces the test status PASS* to detect marginally passing tests.

Chart scaling improvements

Android 17 adds the chart_scaling parameter in config.yml for wider field of view tele camera devices.

New tablet for wide-gamut testing support

The Samsung Galaxy Tab S10 FE is on the tablet allowlist for wide-gamut test charts.

Aggregated result submission for build approvals

Android 17 introduces a process for submitting aggregated Camera ITS test results for build approval.
